_comment: Curriculum Library manifest — Official and Community curricula, each with a permanent curriculumId and one or more versions, each with its own permanent versionId. Schools/classrooms reference a versionId (see models/Classroom.js's curriculumAssignment field), never the curriculum's data directly, so a school can stay on the edition it started the year with even after a newer version is published. Adding a new curriculum, version, grade, or subject means adding JSON here, never touching services/curriculumLibraryService.js. Sample/illustrative data for this milestone — NCERT, CBSE, Kerala State Board, and Cambridge IGCSE are listed for browsing but have no published version yet (empty versions array) — only Samacheer Kalvi Grade 8 Science has real pack content.

official.name: NCERT
official.publisher: National Council of Educational Research and Training

community.name: Kerala State Board
